ops.oldText: shall be owned by Corio, unless such Developments are supported on an ongoing basis by Commerce One in which case Commerce One will retain all ownership rights, including
ops.newText: shall be owned by Corio, including

ops.text: Corio and its Customers shall retain all right, title and interest in and to all data and content submitted to, processed by or stored in the Software, the MarketSite.net Service or the Corio Servers ("CUSTOMER DATA"). No right, title or interest in any Customer Data or in any other Corio intellectual property is assigned or transferred to Commerce One under this Agreement, and nothing in this Agreement creates joint ownership of any Developments or Customer Data.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the carve-out that would hand Commerce One ownership of Developments created solely by Corio merely because Commerce One supports them on an ongoing basis, and added a short confirmation that Corio and its Customers retain all rights in Customer Data with no assignment to Commerce One and no joint ownership. Our position is that we own what we build and pay for while Commerce One keeps its pre-existing Software rights (Section 2.8); if ongoing support is the concern, we can instead grant Commerce One a licence to the relevant Developments for support purposes.
input.summary: Remove vendor ownership carve-out over Corio-created Developments and confirm Corio/Customer retain all rights in Customer Data, with no assignment or joint ownership.
